integrity: The connected infinite-family root count is derived by an explicit bijection and analytic Möbius transformation. The finite sharpness check enumerates every labeled six-vertex graph and includes independent direct-graph matching checks. No external or independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Base-order six sharpness uses an exact fully reproducible finite enumeration, not a symbolic classification; full text of the 2021 global-forcing study was not inspected; unindexed equivalent previous research cannot be excluded. No log-concavity claim is made.
title: Sharp nonreal-root transition for maximal-matching polynomials of triangular coronas
